
  ▲ vercel dev [dir] [options]

  Starts the `vercel dev` server.                                               

  Options:

       --listen <URI>               Specify a URI endpoint on which to listen        
                                    (default: 0.0.0.0:3000)                          
       --local                      Start the dev server without linking to a Vercel 
                                    project                                          
       --project <NAME_OR_ID>       Project name or ID (default: linked project)     
       --queue-port <PORT>          Specify the local Vercel Queues server port      
                                    (default: 4782)                                  
       --runtime-cache-port <PORT>  Specify the local Runtime Cache server port      
                                    (default: 4783)                                  
       --schedules-port <PORT>      Specify the local Vercel Schedules server port   
                                    (default: 4784)                                  
  -y,  --yes                        Accept default value for all prompts             


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - Start the `vercel dev` server on port 8080

    $ vercel dev --listen 8080

  - Make the `vercel dev` server bind to localhost on port 5000

    $ vercel dev --listen 127.0.0.1:5000 

  - Pin local resource server ports

    $ vercel dev --queue-port 5782 --runtime-cache-port 5783 --schedules-port 5784
